title: Algorithmic Complexity And Big O
summary: A skill path for understanding Big O notation through program flow, practical tradeoffs, production scenarios, and interview problems.
audience: Engineers who want Big O notation to feel practical in code reviews, production design, and interviews.

units.title: Notation Foundations
units.summary: Learn the core growth classes, dominant terms, and separate time and space reasoning.

units.title: Program Flow
units.summary: Watch how control flow and data structures change runtime growth for realistic lookup work.

units.title: Production And Interviews
units.summary: Connect complexity explanations to real systems, memory tradeoffs, and existing interview problems.
